DETAILS.TITLE: The Details
DETAILS.INTRO_TEXT: We joyfully invite you to our wedding at the Klausenbauernhof...
DETAILS.TRAVEL_INFO:
We have rented the venue for the whole weekend. You are more than welcome to arrive Friday evening or stay until Sunday morning.

There are some lovely hotels and apartments in the area. The Klausenbauernhof also offers the possibility to sleep in your own van or set up your tent.
DETAILS.BLACK_FOREST_INFO: The Black Forest is a great place to add a few days for hiking, mountain biking or spas.

CONTACT.INTRO: We can't wait to celebrate with you! If you have any questions about the venue, accommodation, or just want to say hi, let us know.
CONTACT.GENERAL_SUB: For RSVP updates or dietary restrictions
CONTACT.DAY_OF_SUB: Please call our lovely maid of honor for urgent matters on the wedding day.

FAQS.TITLE: Q & A
FAQS.INTRO: Here are some answers to the questions we think you might have. If we missed something, just let us know!
FAQS.A_RSVP_DEADLINE: Please let us know if you can make it by July 31st, 2026. This helps us plan the food and seating!
FAQS.A_DRESSCODE: We'd love to see our family and friends get dressed up with us! The dress code is summer-chique - we'd love to see some colours! Please keep in mind that the Klausenbauernhof is an old farm. We'd suggest not wearing your thinnest heels.
FAQS.Q_PLUS_ONE: Can I bring a plus one?
FAQS.A_PLUS_ONE: Our goal is to keep the day as intimate as possible. We can therefore unfortunately not accomodate a plus one.
FAQS.A_KIDS: Yes, we love your little ones! Please put a note in the RSVP so we can plan accordingly.
FAQS.A_GIFTS: A contribution to our honeymoon fund would be appreciated.
FAQS.A_TRANSPORT: Yes, the venue has some parking spots. You can leave your car there overnight if you decide to take a taxi home.
FAQS.Q_ACCOMODATION: Can we sleep at the venue?
FAQS.A_ACCOMODATION: Yes, the venue offers some sleeping spots. Some rooms are available but they are first come, first serve. There are also spaces for your camping-vans or tents. Please let us know, if you're planning to stay at the venue.
